correctness.rationale: The \(21\)-state support transition certificate is exact and exhaustive for every integer \(r\ge1\): the map on (center color, occupied leaf-color set) closes because equal-colored leaves remain identical. The transition graph has one asynchronous recurrent support state \((2,\{0,1,2\})\), and every other state synchronizes by step \(6\), with the complete certificate displayed in RESULT.md. A fixed \(j\)-element leaf support has \(U_j(r)\) surjective labellings by inclusion-exclusion. Multiplying the support counts yields all eight masses, whose sum is \(3^{r+1}\). A distinct labelled-state exhaustive verifier agrees for \(1\le r\le9\); finite experiments supplement rather than replace the all-size proof. Sharpness has an explicit witness with center color \(0\) and leaves of colors \(0\) and \(2\).

value.rationale: The natural degree-three obstruction is qualitative; knowing it exists does not measure its initial-condition frequency or the time distribution among synchronizers. The theorem gives all finite-size basin weights and exact first-arrival layers uniformly over an infinite unbounded-degree family. Its sharp six-step conditional cutoff and nontrivial 1/3-1/3-1/3 asymptotic trichotomy are useful quantitative dynamical invariants, rather than arbitrary finite enumeration or a renamed condition.
